svg.title: Fault injection and recovery lifecycle - Group 4
svg.text: Fault injection and recovery lifecycle (one node at a time, traffic running throughout)
Green boxes: measured in our runs (source in brackets). Other text: documented Cassandra behaviour that the measurement is consistent with.
No step involves leader election: Cassandra has no leader for ordinary reads and writes, so failure-detection time (column 3) is the quantity that replaces 're-election time' in the assignment.
